contexts.text: Remains are like some heavenly constellation...
The very constellations correspond; it is the Societies of Heaven and their abodes with which there is a correspondence of the constellations...
They want to induce on their houses an appearance as of the visible heavens with their constellations, for they believe the abodes of the Angels to be there.
The stars, and the constellations = the Knowledges of truth and of good. References.
The ancients had no other idea... than that the constellations were the abodes of the Angels.
Each star is as a sun in its own place...
The stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light () = the knowledges of truth and good.
The stars () = Knowledges of good; the constellations, Knowledges of truth.
